context: Tests whether the agent correctly converts a Java-style POJO to an idiomatic Kotlin data class while preserving the custom toString that masks sensitive fields, updating setX callers to use copy(), and checking the public-API caveat before converting.

checklist.name: Public API caveat checked
checklist.description: conversion-summary.md explicitly states that ServiceCredential is internal (or confirms it is not on a public binary API) before proceeding with the data class conversion

checklist.name: data class declaration
checklist.description: The output ServiceCredential.kt declares 'data class ServiceCredential(' with a primary constructor — not a regular class

checklist.name: val properties
checklist.description: All four fields (serviceId, clientSecret, accessToken, expiresAtEpochSeconds) in the primary constructor use val, not var

checklist.name: toString preserved
checklist.description: ServiceCredential.kt retains an explicit override fun toString() that redacts clientSecret and accessToken (output does NOT expose their values). The toString body contains '<redacted>' or equivalent masking for both sensitive fields

checklist.name: equals and hashCode removed
checklist.description: ServiceCredential.kt does NOT contain 'override fun equals(' or 'override fun hashCode()' — the compiler-generated versions are used instead

checklist.name: Bean accessors removed
checklist.description: ServiceCredential.kt contains no getServiceId(), setServiceId(), getClientSecret(), setClientSecret(), getAccessToken(), setAccessToken(), getExpiresAtEpochSeconds(), or setExpiresAtEpochSeconds() method declarations

checklist.name: Callers use copy()
checklist.description: TokenRefresher.kt uses .copy(accessToken = ..., ...) or data class constructor calls instead of the bean setter methods (no setServiceId, setClientSecret, setAccessToken, setExpiresAtEpochSeconds calls remain)

checklist.name: Field order preserved
checklist.description: The primary constructor parameters appear in this exact order: serviceId, clientSecret, accessToken, expiresAtEpochSeconds — matching the original field declaration order
